recipe.title: Smoky turkey and peppers with parsley rice
recipe.intro: July peppers are sweet and thin-skinned, and a hot pan chars them in minutes. Lean turkey mince and smoked paprika turn them into a quick, warming supper.
steps: Put the rinsed rice in a saucepan with 600ml of the water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover, turn to the lowest heat and cook for 12 minutes. Take off the heat and leave covered for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over a high heat. Fry the peppers and onion for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until charred at the edges and just soft. Tip onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and the turkey mince to the pan. Fry for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, and leave it alone for a minute at a time so it browns rather than steams.
Stir in the garlic and smoked paprika for a minute, then add the cherry tomatoes and the remaining 50ml water. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the tomatoes burst into a rough sauce.
Return the peppers and onion to the pan, season with salt and black pepper, and heat through for a minute or two.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in most of the parsley. Serve the turkey and peppers on top, scattered with the rest of the parsley.
recipe.tip: Leftovers keep in the fridge for two days and make a good filling for wraps with a spoonful of natural yoghurt.
